newsitem.title: JAPAN: Uruguay mulls launching samurais -- underwriters.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay mulls launching samurais -- underwriters.

text.p: Uruguay is considering launching about 10 billion yen worth of samurai bonds, underwriting sources in Tokyo said on Friday.
"At this stage, Uruguay is expected to launch short- or medium-term samurais, with a duration of about three to five years," an underwriter said.
Uruguay is currently gathering information and studying the condition of the market for the purpose of appointing a lead manager and deciding on specific terms, the sources said.
